title: 2.5 Hours Private Belle Isle Tour with Transportation
includes: Admission to the Dossin Great Lakes Museum (when open)
Private transportation in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle
Downtown Detroit hotel pickup and drop-off
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Detroit’s top island gem on an exclusive 2.5-hour private tour with round-trip luxury transportation. Explore the historic James Scott Memorial Fountain, grand Belle Isle Casino, and rich maritime history at the Dossin Great Lakes Museum. Admire lush flora at the Anna Scripps Whitcomb Conservatory and visit America's oldest aquarium. Finish with stops at the iconic Livingstone Lighthouse, scenic Belle Isle Beach, and unmatched Detroit skyline views at Sunset Point. Perfect for all ages!
